blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all V86 views and poses shows the shorts still fail to cover the upper thighs when seated or crouched. The pose-matched surface-ray diagnostic remains 16.16% upper-thigh coverage for the shorts in sit and 27.80% in crouch; the overskirt remains about 18.5-18.6% seated and 32.8-32.9% crouched. The two new hem rows preserved topology/UV provenance but did not improve these pose coverage results.

The sit render still shows large exposed thighs and pointed folded panel corners around the lower legs; the crouch render likewise shows exposed thighs and angular panel intersections. The new hem subdivisions have not established a usable leg-following deformation.

Direct left/right and three-quarter views retain strong accordion-like corrugation and an uneven projecting overskirt hem. The base-layer shorts hang as a blunt rectangular shell in neutral. Surface appearance and construction remain prototype quality.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
